eventDetail.scope: The ICIIBM is an Internternational Conference that creates opportunities for top technology leaders, industry members, scholars at all levels will gather together to exchange ideas, expend alternative, generate alternative approaches, generate critical dimensions, set the limits of acceptability, reject alternative research approaches, be up-to date of discoveries, make everlasting friends, get new ideas for research projects, and find the answer to unsolved problems. Reflecting on the work of informaticians, biologists, neurologists, and engineers, which is part of the cultural world we live in, which affects many aspects of that world. The conference excites scientists to address open issues in all aspects of informatics, bioinformatics, and neuroscience, and all emerging topics in intelligent informatics and biomedical that will pave the way to reach a new milestone in technology in the years to come, as the effect of new technology on society can draw attention to an old issue.
